title: FLUX.3 Image Klein checkpoints are now available in Diffusers
friendlyTitle: An open FLUX image model now works in Diffusers
summary: Hugging Face said Black Forest Labs' open FLUX.3 Image Klein models are in Diffusers, covering text-to-image, edits from reference images, and layout control with bounding boxes. A distilled checkpoint is set up for faster inference, and NVFP4 and FP8 weights are offered for smaller GPUs. The two-second example Hugging Face cites is for a 1024-pixel image on an H100, not a laptop.
friendlySummary: Black Forest Labs' open FLUX.3 Image Klein models can make images, edit from reference pictures, and place objects with boxes. They now run in the Diffusers library. A faster version is included, plus smaller files for less powerful graphics cards.
whyItMatters: People who generate images can try an open checkpoint inside a common Python library instead of a closed API. Check the licence and your own hardware before assuming it will run locally at that speed.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can try an open image model in a common tool instead of a closed service. The very fast example was measured on a large data-centre chip, so test it on your own computer.
